summary: TWO-WEEK WINDOW (Aug 28 - Sep 11). Paige resigned mid-window and ALTR's only response in the nine days since has been two invoice chases. First half: Vivek made his seventh, eighth and ninth credential asks of the relationship ('@paigeleighx need login code' Aug 28, 'Drop the logins' Aug 29, 'Need approval for the account' Aug 30), producing a sixth plaintext password post in the group chat ('this is @xpaigex18 / [REDACTED-PASSWORD]', Aug 29); Mayson issued a 30-reels-a-month content quota on Aug 30; Mica reappeared after 18 days of silence on Aug 31 with a posting-consistency lecture rather than the reel inspo she had stopped sending on Aug 13; and Stephski's Sep 1 invoice carried 'I ask that you please pay within 7 days to avoid any pausing of work'. In between, on Aug 31, Paige raised a brand-new and serious problem - 'ive got a leak. someone using my stuff on a swingers website x' - Michelle claimed it within seven hours after 44 days of silence, Mayson had to bump her for the link, Paige supplied the exact URL at 03:59 on Sep 1, and as of today, eleven days later, not one word has been said about it. Roughly 31 hours after that silence began she quit: 'hey!! i just wanted to inform that i’m leaving the agency tomorrow! thank you for what you have been doing but its just not working for me I’m sorry! i appreciate the time support and help x' (Sep 2, 11:17). SECOND HALF IS THE INDICTMENT. In the nine days since she gave notice, ALTR has sent her exactly two messages, both from invoicing, both on Sep 9: 'we are still missing payment... If we dont receive we will have to pause work in the morning until we receive' at 00:51, and '@paigeleighx checking back in on this' at 12:33. Derrek has still said nothing - nine days of owner silence on a churning referral client. Vivek has not posted since Aug 30 and his last message on the account is a request from her. Mica, Michelle and Mayson have all gone quiet. Paige herself has been silent for nine days and never answered Mayson's call offer. The agency is now threatening to pause work for a client who resigned a week earlier, on an account where the last three things she asked for - a lockout closure, a takedown, an explanation - were all left unanswered. Someone was added to this chat at 21:01 on Sep 10 and posted nothing. The final invoice (Aug 15-31, sent Sep 1, 7-day term) is three days past term and is the first genuinely unpaid invoice in five cycles from a client who paid every single time.

health.rationale: Down 5 from 10, a sixth consecutive decline (82 -> 66 -> 57 -> 48 -> 10 -> 5). The prior score of 10 was held up entirely by the argument that a save was still technically live: she was non-hostile, her notice said 'tomorrow' rather than immediately, and Mayson's call offer was open. Nine days later every one of those props is gone. Derrek never responded - that is 9 days of total owner silence on a churn notice from a referral client, and the single recommendation every prior file led with. The exit call was never booked. The leak takedown, the one concrete act that would still have visibly helped her, is 11 days dead with the URL sitting in the chat unread; Nick (DMCA) was never engaged despite a DMCA topic existing here since Jun 24. The Aug 26 lockout is 16 days open and was never closed, diagnosed or explained. Credential remediation is 44 days old and she has left with a live password of hers in an ALTR group chat. What ALTR did instead, and the only thing it did: chase her for money twice on Sep 9, the second chase threatening to 'pause work in the morning' for a client who had resigned seven days earlier and was receiving no work to pause. That message is now the last thing Paige has heard from this agency. The prior state file explicitly said 'Do NOT chase the Sep 1 invoice with a pause threat - she is already leaving and the threat is what she read last', and it happened anyway, which means the internal systems never registered the churn at all. The only points left on the board are that she has not disputed anything, has not gone public, and Stephski's chase at least offered a clean route ('send me a screen shot of the confirmation so I can mark you down as paid'). This is not zero only because there is no hostility and no dispute yet.
